abstract: A 29-year-old man was referred to our hospital with loss of appetite and a left lower abdominal mass. A small nodule was palpable in his left testis and ultrasonographic examination demonstrated that the nodule was low echoic. Computed tomography showed a large mass in his left retroperitoneal space. We thought the mass was a metastatic lesion from a testicular tumor. Left orchiectomy was done and microscopic examination revealed no viable tumor cells. Only fibrous tissue, small calcified areas, and hyaline bodies were found. As tumor markers were normalized after 3 courses of chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatine, the retroperitoneal mass was removed with the left kidney. It consisted of embryonal carcinoma, mature teratoma, and yolk sac tumor. One course of adjuvant chemotherapy was done and the patient has since been free from recurrence. We suppose that the tumor was a so-called 'burned-out' testicular tumor.
abstract_ja: 29歳の男性が食欲不振と左下腹部の腫瘤を主訴に当院を紹介受診した。左精巣に小結節を触知し、超音波検査では低エコー性であった。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では左後腹膜腔に大きな腫瘤を認めた。精巣腫瘍からの転移性病変と考え、左精巣摘除術を施行したが、顕微鏡検査では生存腫瘍細胞は認められず、線維組織、小さな石灰化巣、硝子体様小体のみであった。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる3コースの化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーが正常化したため、後腹膜腫瘤を左腎とともに摘出した。腫瘤は胎児性癌、成熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍から構成されていた。補助化学療法を1コース施行し、以後患者は再発なく経過している。本腫瘍はいわゆる焼失型精巣腫瘍であったと考えられる。
